dialogues.en: <$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>Oh... You’re right. You don’t really look all that scary.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>Um, so, I was just sleeping at home before...
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,48)>And then this awful sound woke me up, and I dunno how,
but I was on this ship!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>Estava a dormir em casa antes...
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,48)>E então este som horrível me acordou, e eu não sei como,
Mas eu estava neste navio!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,23)><$motion(4,807)><$facial(4,9)>And even worse, I still hear the sound sometimes. I’m
getting scared...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,23)><$motion(4,807)><$facial(4,9)>E ainda pior, eu ainda ouço o som às vezes.
A ficar assustado...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,29)>You seem sorta strong. Could you find out what the
sound is for me?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,29)>Pareces um bocado forte.
O som é para mim?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,8)>Really? Thank you!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,8)>A sério?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,8)>Really? Thank you!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,8)>A sério?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)>I think the sound’s coming from down lower in the ship.
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>I peeked through that hole to check, but it was too dark to
see anything.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)>Eu acho que o som está vindo de baixo no navio.
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>Olhei por aquele buraco para verificar, mas estava muito escuro para
Ver qualquer coisa.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,27)>I can sometimes hear this really scary sound from down in
the bottom of the ship!
<$voicel(4,6)><$emotion(4,49)>Could you go figure out what’s making the noise?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,27)>Às vezes, ouço um som assustador lá de baixo.
O fundo da nave!
<$voicel(4,6)><$emotion(4,49)>Você poderia ir descobrir o que está fazendo o barulho?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>It seems like I always hear the sound at the same time
of day...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>Parece que ouço sempre o som ao mesmo tempo.
do dia...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,27)>Oh! Did you figure out what the sound was?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,27)>Descobriste qual era o som?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(4,3)>I dunno how come there was an alarm clock on this ship.
<$voicel(4,5)>But this room is really relaxing. It reminds me of home!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(4,3)>Não sei como é que havia um despertador nesta nave.
<$voicel(4,5)>Mas este quarto é muito relaxante, lembra-me a minha casa!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(4,7)>And if you put that <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1702)> in here for me,
<$voicel(4,9)>I think it’ll feel even more like my home!
<$voicel(4,8)>Like this!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(4,7)>E se você colocar isso <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1702)> aqui para mim,
<$voicel(4,9)>Eu acho que vai se sentir ainda mais como a minha casa!
<$voicel(4,8)>Assim!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)>Could you please put an <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1702)></color> in my room?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,8)>Like this!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,8)>Assim!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,8)>YAY, thank you! It really looks like my home now!
<$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,49)>I’m gonna live HERE from now on!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,8)>Parece mesmo a minha casa agora!
<$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,49)>Eu vou viver AQUI a partir de agora!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>I wanna do something to say thank you, though... Oh!
I know!
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,806)>I found a really interesting machine on this ship!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>Quero fazer uma coisa para te agradecer.
Eu sei!
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,806)>Encontrei uma máquina muito interessante nesta nave!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,38)>I’ll show it to you! Come on, follow me!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,38)>Eu vou mostrar-lhe! Vamos, siga-me!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,38)>I wanna show you something neat as thanks for helping
me! Come on, let’s go!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,38)>Quero mostrar-te algo puro como obrigado por ajudares.
Eu! Vamos, vamos!

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Wait... That smell! Do you have <$cdef(27)><$ifull(8)> with you

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Espera... esse cheiro! <$cdef(27)><$ifull(8)> com você.

dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,8)>Sim, estes parecem tão saborosos.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>OK! As promised, I’ll show you the trick to storing water.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>OK! Como prometido, vou mostrar-lhe o truque para armazenar água.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>So first, you gotta jump right in the water! Splash!
<$voicel(4,10)><$comeff(4,5)><$motionoff(4,804)>Then suck up the water like SCHWOOOP!
<$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,49)>Yup, basically like that!

<$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>Primeiro, tem de saltar para a água!
<$voicel(4,10)><$comeff(4,5)><$motionoff(4,804)>Então, chupa a água como o SCHWOOOP!
